hooks.command:
jq -r '"
## Tool failure: " + (.tool_name // "unknown") + " (" + (now | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) + ")
- Error: `" + ((.error // .tool_response.error // .message // "unknown error") | tostring) + "`
- Input: `" + (.tool_input | tostring) + "`"' >> .claude/knowledge/errors.md 2>/dev/null || true
